limitations: Source: Ministry of Commerce public data centre, goods-trade monthly statistics. Its ordinary public HTML explicitly loads imexmonth.js, which declares the read-only POST query and startDate/endDate parameters; the form declares yyyyMM. Only July/August 2026 was requested. No remote script was executed, hidden endpoint guessed or access control bypassed.

All 20 displayed statistical numbers were obtained in the actual two-row JSON response. Table headers establish amount units as USD hundred million (亿美元); the three *_per fields are publisher YoY percentages. Monthly amounts, YTD amounts and the monthly trade balance remain distinct.
The requested public query has no verified original publication date; published_at remains null. Actual acquisition time is recorded, and no historical point-in-time availability is asserted.

This is MOFCOM distribution of China official goods-trade statistics with Customs upstream, not an independent second measurement of the same trade flows. Values are monetary statistics, not commodity tonnage or current tradable quotes.

The response includes unpopulated additional fields; their field names are retained in null_fields and are not turned into zeros. Published YTD changes need not equal monthly levels because the acquired release may contain revisions; do not subtract YTD rows to reconstruct a month or correct the published table.

Necessary factual numerical excerpt and original curation with attribution. No full database licence, continuous access entitlement or unrestricted upstream API reuse is inferred. The existing read-source consumer restores the exact retained CSV; generic price/period comparison is not asserted.
